verdict.label: FAKE
verdict.headline: The image shows clear signs of manipulation.

ai_analysis.headline: The image shows clear signs of manipulation.
ai_analysis.summary: Our forensic tools detected irregularities in a central portion of the picture. The evidence strongly suggests the image has been altered, and we are highly confident in this assessment.

analysis.overview: We first ran an automated face detector to locate any human subjects. The detected face was aligned and cropped before being examined by a forensic analysis engine. The engine generated an attention map highlighting areas that contributed most to its decision. The highlighted region overlapped a sizable portion of the image, leading the system to label the media as fake.
analysis.heatmap_interpretation: The attention map focused on a square area near the upper‑middle of the picture. This region includes unnatural edge transitions and inconsistent lighting that are typical of splicing or cloning operations.
analysis.region_focus: The analysis concentrated on a 287 × 287 pixel block starting at (163, 12), roughly the middle of the width and the upper third of the height.

ai_analysis.confidence_statement: We are about 90% confident that the image has been tampered with.
ai_analysis.limitations: The analysis is limited to visual artifacts and cannot assess the provenance of the file. It cannot determine the intent behind the manipulation or identify the exact tools used.
ai_analysis.recommendation: We recommend further investigation, including checking original source files and metadata, before drawing final conclusions.
